late_correction.scope: A generic square-root small-ball / half-Riesz endpoint certificate, even with an L2 residual density, cannot by itself be combined with one independent cap-one square to imply bounded density.

impact_on_this_run.reason: The new one-copy L-infinity splice does not use a bare square plus H_(1/2). It first derives H_(1/4) from a determinant-only collision/L2 theorem and then applies the pinned coordinate-hyperbola peel, whose proved interface is exactly H_(1/4).
impact_on_this_run.future_guard: Do not use a third independent square to upgrade a bare H_(1/2) or rho^(1/2) residual certificate to L-infinity without an exponent gain or richer retained product/cancellation structure.
